description: This PHP class defines the model for handling extension data in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving extension records, filtering by type and code, and fetching installation data from the database.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for managing extension data in the database within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves all extension records from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Fetches extensions filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension record based on type and code.
